intro.text: Welcome to the world music festival! Pick a lantern on the map, and let's dance around the world!

choose-prompt.text: Where shall we dance? Tap a glowing lantern on the map!

your-turn.text: Now it's your turn! Watch the dancer, and find the matching move!

copy-intro.text: Can you copy the dance? Watch closely!

map-prompt.text: You earned the dance card! Drag it home to its place on the map!

placed-cheer.text: You did it! The card is home!

collection-complete.text: Hooray! You danced all around the whole wide world! What a festival!

again-prompt.text: Tap another lantern to keep dancing!

nudge-copy.text: Good try! Watch the dancer one more time, then tap the move that matches.

nudge-map.text: Almost! Look for the glowing lantern, and drop the card right there.

nudge-idle.text: Tap a card to keep the party going!

praise-4.text: That's it! What a dancer you are!

greet-india.text: Namaste! We're in India! This dance is called Kathak. Hear the sitar sing — watch the dancer twirl!

fact-india.text: In India, Kathak dancers wear tiny bells on their ankles that jingle with every step!

move-india-1.text: Twirl like a spinning wheel! Find the twirling move!

move-india-2.text: Stamp, stamp, jingle the bells! Find the stamping move!

move-india-3.text: Wave your arms like a swaying lotus! Find the waving move!

greet-brazil.text: Olá! Welcome to Brazil! It's carnival time — this dance is the samba!

fact-brazil.text: In Brazil, samba dancers parade through the streets at carnival, with feathers as bright as parrots!

move-brazil-1.text: Bounce with quick, happy feet! Find the bouncing move!

move-brazil-2.text: Open your arms wide and sway! Find the swaying move!

move-brazil-3.text: Spin and let the feathers fly! Find the spinning move!

greet-japan.text: Konnichiwa! We're in Japan! At the summer festival, everyone dances the Bon Odori!

fact-japan.text: In Japan, people dance Bon Odori in a big circle around a tower of drums, under paper lanterns!

move-japan-1.text: Reach up high, like catching the moon! Find the reaching move!

move-japan-2.text: Clap, then take a little step! Find the clapping move!

move-japan-3.text: Sweep your fan through the air! Find the fan move!

greet-ghana.text: Akwaaba! Welcome to Ghana! Hear the drums? This dance is called Kpanlogo!

fact-ghana.text: In Ghana, drummers and dancers talk to each other — the drum asks, and the dancer answers!

move-ghana-1.text: Stomp and clap with the big drum! Find the stomping move!

move-ghana-2.text: Bend your knees and row like a boat! Find the rowing move!

move-ghana-3.text: Make great big circles with your arms! Find the circling move!

greet-mexico.text: ¡Hola! We're in Mexico! The trumpets are playing — it's time for folklórico!

fact-mexico.text: In Mexico, folklórico dancers swish giant rainbow skirts that swirl like butterfly wings!

move-mexico-1.text: Swish your skirt from side to side! Find the swishing move!

move-mexico-2.text: Tap your heels, quick quick quick! Find the heel-tapping move!

move-mexico-3.text: Twirl till your skirt opens like a flower! Find the twirling move!

greet-ireland.text: Hello from Ireland! The tin whistle is playing a jig — quick, dancing feet!

fact-ireland.text: In Irish dancing, your feet hop and skip as fast as raindrops, but your arms stay very still!

move-ireland-1.text: Hop and kick, light as a feather! Find the hopping move!

move-ireland-2.text: Point your toe, tip tap tip! Find the toe-pointing move!

move-ireland-3.text: Quick feet, then a little spin! Find the quick-feet move!
